html:
A teacher and trade unionist from the Sara people of the south who led Chad to independence on 11 August 1960 and ruled until he was killed in a coup on 13 April 1975.

He banned other parties in 1962 and filled the state with southerners. Heavy taxes and abuses by officials in the Muslim north and east set off revolts from 1965 that grew into the civil war, and French troops had to help him. In the 1970s his authenticity campaign renamed places, including the capital as N'Djamena, and forced southern civil servants through the yondo initiation rites. Soldiers killed him. See also Chad.
